column1: # The skip ledger of the JSON Schema Test Suite's draft7 tests (README.md): one row
# per test the import cannot honour yet, in the ports that fail it, with the keywords it
# waits on. A * in test covers a whole group, and in group and test a whole file. Each
# runner fails on a failing test no row covers, on a covered test that passes, and on a
# ledger longer than its bound. Columns: file, group, test, ports, waits on.
